results.title: Common cold after allergies asked; paracetamol 1 g TDS

turns.english: Hello. What brings you in?
I have had a cold for two days, my nose is running, and my throat is a little scratchy.
Any fever? Any allergies to medicines?
turns.translation: के तपाईंलाई ज्वरो छ? के तपाईंलाई कुनै औषधिहरूको एलर्जी छ?

turns.english: No fever. No allergies either.

coherence: coherence check u007 (plan) → no hold · 1.77 s
turns.english: It's a common cold. Paracetamol 1 g three times a day for three days if needed, warm salt-water gargles and plenty of fluids.
turns.translation: यो साधारण ज्वरो हो। यदि आवश्यक परेमा, तीन दिनसम्म दिनमा तीन पटक १ ग्राम प्यारेसेटामोल लिनुहोस्, नुन पानीले गार्गल गर्नुहोस् र धेरै तरल पदार्थहरू पिउनुहोस्।

turns.english: Thank you doctor sir.
